scope: bounded source availability probe; no concentration recomputation or packet change

findings.baoUsableNow: BaoStock login, three recent stock history queries, one 2023 historical gap query and both catalog queries returned errorCode=0. One stock query covers the 11 recent trading dates plus earlier overlap. This is a small sample, not proof of full-market reliability.
findings.lifecycleInterpretation: Bao history has no outDate-day row for three tested exited securities. Treat supplier outDate as exclusive in the observed supplier pool only after the builder checks this lifecycle change against its frozen source set; missing amount is not zero. 601198 also has independently located exchange termination notice in root audit. Current Bao master is a Nov 8 snapshot, not point-in-time historical membership evidence.
findings.suspension: sz.000016 had status=0 with blank amount and volume on Oct 19-22, and no row Oct 23-Nov 6. Its supplier outDate=Oct 23; do not extend zero amount past Oct 22.
findings.eastmoneyAmountUnit: f57 is displayed in yuan: sh.601326 Oct 19 Eastmoney 99034859.00 vs BaoStock 99034859.2000; sh.600696 Jan 3 2023 Eastmoney 65828041.00 vs BaoStock 65828040.7900. Eastmoney integer-yuan rounding should not silently replace Bao originals.
findings.eastmoneyCompleteness: sh.601326 Eastmoney returned only Oct 19, Oct 20, Nov 4, Nov 5, Nov 6 for a window in which BaoStock returned 15 rows. Adding lmt=30 did not recover missing dates. Hence this Eastmoney endpoint is not a safe complete-window primary source.

catalog.note: Snapshot catalog uses type=1 and sh.60/sh.68/sz.00/sz.30 prefixes; reconcile against old v8 source membership before changing historical denominator.
